claim_boundary: This public benchmark successor is not the unopened blind NC-EXT-EVAL-V0 study and cannot rehabilitate the falsified historical typed-parser causal claim.
research_question: How often does the frozen deterministic NeuroCAD frontend plus a semantics-preserving CadQuery B-Rep exporter satisfy externally authored CADTestBench requirements without task-specific tuning?

population.selection: all records in both pinned partitions
exclusions: invalid or unreadable pinned dataset row

primary: CADTestBench sample pass rate PR for each partition
CADTestBench requirement satisfaction RS for each partition
secondary: all rejection, compile, export and CADTest failures
endpoints.uncertainty: Report exact numerator/denominator and two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for binary sample-level rates.
endpoints.aggregation: Never average abstract and detailed into one headline number.

comparators.official_paper_baselines: Report only as externally published benchmark results unless their exact saved outputs are recomputed under the pinned evaluator.

integrity.post_outcome_rule: No parser, exporter, exclusion, metric or retry change may replace this run. Any change requires NC-CADTESTBENCH-V2 and preserves V1.

compute.rationale: The method and CADTests are deterministic CPU workloads; allocating a GPU does not strengthen the inference.
compute.hosted_target: Kaggle CPU unless a separately frozen learned comparator is added
